evidence_notes: Daniel, 37, has had Crohn's for ten years. He also has ankylosing spondylitis (AS) and chronic kidney disease. He was initially misdiagnosed and took NSAIDs for AS, which damaged his kidneys. He was diagnosed with both Crohn's and AS and started Remicade, which initially worked. When Remicade stopped working, he switched to Humira, which was less effective. He is now on disability, divorced, and living alone. He is struggling with conflicting advice from specialists and the impact of his illnesses on his life. He is considering surgery for Crohn's and is being offered Stelara.
